LanguageData.CC_Win_What_Council: the colony's own life: this week, its people, the council and the colony
LanguageData.CC_Win_What_World: the region map and everything beyond the colony
LanguageData.CC_Win_What_Planning: planning the base and its rooms
LanguageData.CC_Settings_WorldButton: Show the "region" button in the bottom bar
LanguageData.CC_Settings_WorldButton_Tip: A button next to the council's that opens the region window: the region map with its lenses, the peoples of the world and their faces, who is here and who is away, and the history. Hidden, the region window is still one click away in the top right corner of Rimfolk's other windows.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_WorldButton: A Region button in the bottom bar, with the region map and everything beyond the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Mode_Map_Tip: The region map, read through the lens.
LanguageData.CC_Mode_List_Tip: What the lens shows, as a list. A click on a row opens its card beside it.
LanguageData.CC_Mode_Peoples_Tip: Each people of the world in a list, closest first, and the one chosen on a page: how it stands with the colony, how to reach it, its towns, its people, your dealings and its history, and what the colony can do with it.
LanguageData.CC_Mode_Faces_Tip: The people the colony knows by name, its old foes, those who left, and the faces it keeps up with.
LanguageData.CC_Lens_Land_Tip: The land as it lies, each place in its people's colours.
LanguageData.CC_Lens_Stance_Tip: Each town by how its people stand with the colony, with a line from home for each tie between you.
LanguageData.CC_Lens_Fortunes_Tip: Each town by how it is faring, an arrow where that changed this season, and the world's events where they are.
LanguageData.CC_Lens_Threats_Tip: Hostile towns, raiders' camps and the homes they threaten, and the fights on their way.
LanguageData.CC_Lens_Trade_Tip: The trading posts and the towns that trade with the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Lens_Ours_Tip: The colony's homes, its hamlets and its caravans out on the land.
LanguageData.CC_Lens_Land_Line: The land around the colony and the places on it.
LanguageData.CC_Lens_Stance_Line: How each town's people stand with the colony, and a line from home for each tie.
LanguageData.CC_Lens_Fortunes_Line: How each town is faring, from struggling to flourishing, and what moved it.
LanguageData.CC_Lens_Threats_Line: Hostile towns, raiders' camps and fights on their way, and the homes they threaten.
LanguageData.CC_Lens_Trade_Line: The colony's trading posts and the towns that deal with it.
LanguageData.CC_Lens_Ours_Line: The colony's own homes, hamlets and caravans out on the land.
LanguageData.CC_Lens_Land_Empty: The towns within the map's reach show here, nearest first; a wider reach, set above the map, takes in more.
LanguageData.CC_Lens_Stance_Empty: The towns within reach show here with the people the colony knows there; a visit, a trade or a letter brings their names.
LanguageData.CC_Lens_Fortunes_Empty: The towns within reach show here by how they fare, while the region's fortunes are on in the settings.
LanguageData.CC_Lens_Threats_Empty: Nothing threatens the colony now; hostile towns within reach, raiders' camps found and fights a people promised show here.
LanguageData.CC_Lens_Trade_Empty: The towns within reach that trade with the colony show here, and a trading post once a friendly people far off trades with it often enough to open one.
LanguageData.CC_Lens_Ours_Empty: The colony's homes show here, with a hamlet once settlers ask to found one and its caravans while they are out.
LanguageData.CC_Lens_Stance_Group0: Towns and who the colony knows there
LanguageData.CC_Lens_Leg_HeadRing: a ring for how the town's head regards the colony
LanguageData.CC_Lens_Leg_OursAll: the colony's homes, hamlets and caravans
LanguageData.CC_Lens_Leg_Ruin: a ruin, or a town being built
LanguageData.CC_Lens_Leg_Threatened: a home with a threat now
LanguageData.CC_Lens_ShowTip: Show it on the map, its card beside it.
LanguageData.CC_Lens_NobodyKnown: The colony knows none of its people by name yet.
LanguageData.CC_Lens_BuildingBy: Settlers of {PEOPLE} are building a town here.
LanguageData.CC_Peoples_Line: Each people of the world, closest first: how it stands with the colony, and what to do with it.
LanguageData.CC_Faces_Line: The people the colony knows by name, and who is out there with the colony on their mind.
LanguageData.CC_Faces_Known_Off: Neighbours by name are switched off in the settings.
LanguageData.CC_Faces_Foes_None: No nemesis, grudge or rival is out there now; one who escapes the colony or a people it wronged shows here.
LanguageData.CC_Faces_Left_None: No colonist who left is known to be out there; one who quits or is sent away shows here.
LanguageData.CC_Faces_Others_None: None of the others out there has the colony on their mind; a hunt, pilgrims or a story under way shows here.
LanguageData.CC_Away_Line: Who is here from outside, what is on its way, letters on the road, and who of the colony's is away.
LanguageData.CC_WHist_Line: What the world remembers, newest first.
LanguageData.CC_WHist_None_Colony: Nothing in the colony's history matches yet; what it does and what is done to it shows here.
LanguageData.CC_WHist_None_Region: Nothing in the region's history matches yet; what happens in the towns within reach and to the colony shows here.
LanguageData.CC_WHist_None_World: Nothing in the history matches yet; what the world remembers shows here as it happens.
LanguageData.CC_WHist_NoEvents: No world event is running now; plagues, famines, wars and hard winters show here while they last.
LanguageData.CC_WHist_Scope_Colony_Tip: What the colony did and what was done to it, its homes and its people.
LanguageData.CC_WHist_Scope_Region_Tip: The colony's history and that of the towns within reach, their peoples and the people of them the colony knows.
LanguageData.CC_WHist_Scope_World_Tip: Everything the world remembers, near and far.
LanguageData.CC_WHist_Letters_Tip: The colony's letters and calls of the last days, those on the road and how the others were answered.
LanguageData.CC_WHist_More_Tip: Pages other mods added to the region window.
LanguageData.CC_LettersPg_NoneLately: No letter or call of the colony's is recent; one written from a person's card or from Peoples, under Faces, shows here.
LanguageData.CC_Peoples_Sub: How each people stands with the colony, whom it is at war with, and what it remembers.
LanguageData.CC_Peoples_None: The colony knows of no other people yet.
LanguageData.CC_Peoples_EveryonesFoe: At war with everyone, as their kind always is.
LanguageData.CC_Peoples_TheirHistoryTip: What {PEOPLE} took part in, in the region window's History.
LanguageData.CC_LettersPg_Off: Neighbours by name are switched off in the settings, and letters and calls with them.
LanguageData.CC_LettersPg_Sub: What the colony has written or called its neighbours about, where each letter is, and whom it can write to.
LanguageData.CC_LettersPg_NoneUnderWay: No letter or call is under way.
LanguageData.CC_LettersPg_WriteTo: Whom the colony can write to
LanguageData.CC_LettersPg_NoOne: Nobody in the towns nearby is known to the colony by name yet.
LanguageData.CC_JourneysPg_Sub: The journey planned ahead from the colony, and its caravans out on the land.
LanguageData.CC_JourneysPg_Off: Journeys planned ahead are switched off in the settings.
LanguageData.CC_JourneysPg_NoneAway: No caravan of the colony's is out on the land.
LanguageData.CC_EventsPg_Sub: What's going on in the world around the colony, and what it has brought lately.
LanguageData.CC_EventsPg_Off: World events are switched off in the settings.
LanguageData.CC_WHist_Sub: What the world remembers, newest first: the peoples, the towns and the colony.
